query:
WITH doomed AS (
                SELECT e.item_id
                  FROM queue_entry e JOIN item i ON i.id = e.item_id
                 WHERE e.box_id = $1 AND i.status IN ('done', 'closed')
                 ORDER BY e.item_id
                   FOR UPDATE OF e)
            DELETE FROM queue_entry e
             USING doomed d
             WHERE e.item_id = d.item_id
